output_list.criticism: The integer overflow vulnerability is present in the XBornID() function. The totalDistributed variable is assigned to the owner's balance, which can result in an overflow if the totalDistributed value exceeds the maximum uint256 value. This vulnerability can lead to incorrect balances and potentially loss of funds.

The integer overflow vulnerability is present in the distr() function. The totalDistributed and totalRemaining variables are updated using the add() and sub() functions from the SafeMath library. If the addition or subtraction operation results in an overflow, it can cause the contract to behave unpredictably. This vulnerability can lead to incorrect balances and potentially loss of funds.

The integer overflow vulnerability is present in the getTokens() function. The value variable is updated using the div() and mul() functions from the SafeMath library. If the division or multiplication operation results in an overflow, it can cause the contract to behave unpredictably. This vulnerability can lead to incorrect balances and potentially loss of funds.

The integer overflow vulnerability is present in the transfer() function. The balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to] variables are updated using the sub() function from the SafeMath library. If the subtraction operation results in an overflow, it can cause the contract to behave unpredictably. This vulnerability can lead to incorrect balances and potentially loss of funds.
